title: Meeting room change
script:
Man: Hi, Megan. Are you still using the small meeting room on the third floor this afternoon?
Woman: No, the projector there is broken. I booked Room 4 instead.
Man: Room 4 is on the second floor, right?
Woman: Yes. It's next to the kitchen and it has a bigger screen.
Man: Great. I'll tell the sales team to meet there at two.
Woman: Thanks. I'll also send them a revised schedule of topics.
translation:
男性:やあ、メグ。今日の午後も3階の小会議室を使う?
女性:いいえ、そこのプロジェクターが壊れているの。代わりに4号室を予約したわ。
男性:4号室は2階だよね?
女性:そう。キッチンの隣で、画面も大きいのよ。
男性:いいね。営業チームに2時にそこへ集まるよう伝えておくよ。
女性:ありがとう。議題の修正版も彼らに送っておくわ。

questions.question: Why did the woman change the meeting room?
choices: The projector in the first room does not work.
The room is too small for the sales team.
The meeting was moved to tomorrow.
The sales team asked for a larger kitchen.
questions.explanation: 女性は3階の会議室のプロジェクターが壊れているため、4号室に変えた。

questions.question: What will the woman send to the sales team?
choices: A list of new engineers.
An updated list of agenda items.
A budget report for next year.
A map of the building.
questions.explanation: 女性は営業チームに議題の修正版を送ると言っている。

questions.question: What will the sales team do at two o'clock?
choices: Visit the second floor.
Have lunch in the kitchen.
Hold a gathering in Room 4.
Test a new projector.
questions.explanation: 男性は営業チームに2時に4号室へ集まるよう伝えると言っている。

title: Copier paper shortage
script:
Woman: Hi, Tom, the copier on the fourth floor is out of paper again.
Man: We ordered a box last week. Did it not arrive?
Woman: No, the supply company said the order was delayed.
Man: I'll call them now and ask them to deliver it today.
Woman: Thanks. Can you also check whether we have toner in the storage room?
Man: Sure. I'll look after I finish this report.
translation:
女性:やあ、トム。4階のコピー機がまた紙切れなの。
男性:先週1箱頼んだよね。届いていないの?
女性:ええ、納入業者が注文は遅れていると言っていたわ。
男性:今すぐ電話して、今日中に届けてもらうよ。
女性:ありがとう。ついでに倉庫にトナーがあるかも確認してくれる?
男性:いいよ。このレポートを終えたら見ておくね。

questions.question: What is the problem with the copier?
choices: It has no toner left.
It is making a loud noise.
It has run out of paper.
It is on the wrong floor.
questions.explanation: 女性は4階のコピー機の紙がまた切れていると言っている。

questions.question: Why has the order not arrived?
choices: It was sent to the wrong address.
The box was too heavy to move.
The supplier said it was late.
The order was canceled by mistake.
questions.explanation: 納入業者は注文が遅れていると説明した。

questions.question: What will the man do first?
choices: Check the storage room.
Finish his report.
Phone the supplier.
Repair the copier.
questions.explanation: 男性は今すぐ業者に電話すると言っている。

title: Team lunch venue
graphic:
Lunch options
Restaurant      Price per person   Walk from office
Thai            $12                5 min
Italian         $18                10 min
Sushi bar       $14                25 min
Diner           $9                 15 min
script:
Man: Lisa, we need to pick a place for the team lunch next Thursday.
Woman: Let's avoid the Thai place. Half the team is vegetarian, and it has few vegetarian dishes.
Man: The diner doesn't have many vegetarian options either.
Woman: Then the sushi bar? It's the cheapest one we can still consider.
Man: It's a 25-minute walk from the office. Can everyone get there by noon?
Woman: Probably not. Let's pick the closer one with vegetarian dishes and confirm by Wednesday.
translation:
男性:リサ、来週木曜のチームランチの店を決めないと。
女性:タイ料理の店は避けましょう。チームの半分はベジタリアンで、ベジタリアン向けの料理が少ないの。
男性:ダイナーもベジタリアン向けがあまりないよ。
女性:じゃあ寿司店は? 検討できる中では一番安いわ。
男性:オフィスから歩いて25分かかるよ。12時までに全員着けるかな?
女性:たぶん無理ね。近くて、ベジタリアン向けの料理がある店にして、水曜までに確定しましょう。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which restaurant should the team choose?
choices: The cheapest one that is still reasonable.
The one that is closest and has vegetarian dishes.
The one with the longest walk from the office.
The one with the highest price per person.
questions.explanation: タイ料理は菜食向けの料理が少なく、ダイナーも同様。寿司店は遠すぎる。残るのは近くて菜食向けの料理がある店。

questions.question: Why does the woman reject the Thai restaurant?
choices: Its menu lacks suitable choices for the group's diet.
It is too far from the office.
It is more expensive than the others.
It cannot take bookings for a group.
questions.explanation: 女性はチームの半分がベジタリアンなので、菜食向けの料理が少ないタイ料理店を避けたいと言っている。

questions.question: What will the team do by Wednesday?
choices: Ask the team members about their diets.
Pay for the lunch in advance.
Walk to the sushi bar.
Confirm the restaurant.
questions.explanation: 女性は水曜までに店を決めて確定させると言っている。

title: Training session reschedule
script:
Woman: Mr. Park, I'm calling about the safety training on Friday morning.
Man: Yes, I was going to ask you about that. Several people are on the night shift that week.
Woman: Then we could move it to Friday afternoon, after their shift ends at noon.
Man: That might work for the night crew, but the trainer is only free before one o'clock.
Woman: Then let's book the training room for eleven and tell everyone the start time.
Man: Good. I'll send the new time to the night shift staff today.
translation:
女性:パークさん、金曜午前の安全研修のことで電話しています。
男性:ええ、その件で聞こうと思っていたんです。その週は夜勤の人が何人かいるんですよね。
女性:それなら金曜の午後に移して、正午に夜勤が終わってからにしてはどうでしょう。
男性:夜勤の人たちにはそれでいいかもしれませんが、講師は1時前しか空いていないんです。
女性:じゃあ研修室を11時で予約して、全員に開始時刻を伝えましょう。
男性:いいですね。今日中に夜勤の職員に新しい時刻を送っておきます。

questions.question: Why does the man say the trainer should be available before one o'clock?
choices: The training room closes at one o'clock.
The instructor can only attend before the early afternoon.
The night shift starts at one o'clock.
The training costs less before one o'clock.
questions.explanation: 男性は講師が1時前しか空いていないと言っている。

questions.question: What is the woman's suggestion about the training?
choices: Cancel it until next month.
Hold it on Thursday evening.
Give it to the night shift staff only.
Shift it to later on the Friday.
questions.explanation: 女性は研修を金曜午後に移すことを提案している。

questions.question: What will the man do today?
choices: Notify the night-shift employees of the revised time.
Book the training room for eleven.
Call the trainer about the price.
Ask the staff to work overtime.
questions.explanation: 男性は今日中に夜勤の職員に新しい時刻を送ると言っている。

title: Budget proposal feedback
script:
Man: Karen, I looked at the marketing budget proposal. Your numbers for the online ads seem high.
Woman: They include the new video campaign, which the client specifically asked for.
Man 2: Maybe we can split the video work into two phases and test the first one.
Woman: That would cut the cost in the short term, but we'd lose the momentum for the launch.
Man: Let's think about the trade-off. Launching late could cost us more than the savings.
Woman: Fair enough. I'll keep the full plan and send the revised budget on Monday.
Man 2: Can you also add a line about the expected return for each phase?
translation:
男性:カレン、マーケティング予算案を見たよ。オンライン広告の金額が多すぎないかな。
女性:それには新しい動画キャンペーンが含まれていて、これは顧客が特に求めたものなの。
男性2:動画の作業を2段階に分けて、最初の段階だけ試すのはどうでしょう。
女性:短期的にはコストが下がるけど、発売に向けた勢いを失ってしまうわ。
男性:費用対効果を考えよう。発売が遅れると、節約額より損失が大きいかもしれない。
女性:もっともね。計画は全部のまま、修正した予算を月曜に送るわ。
男性2:各段階で見込まれる利益も一行加えてもらえますか。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "Fair enough"?
choices: She wants to test the first phase right away.
She accepts the man's point about the launch timing.
She thinks the client should pay more.
She will cancel the video campaign.
questions.explanation: 女性は「もっともね」と言い、発売を遅らせる損失という男性の指摘を受け入れている。

questions.question: What does the woman plan to do?
choices: Proceed with the whole plan and send amended numbers on Monday.
Split the video work into two phases.
Cut the online advertising budget by half.
Drop the campaign the client requested.
questions.explanation: 女性は計画を全部のまま、修正予算を月曜に送ると言っている。

questions.question: What does the second man ask the woman to add?
choices: A new video of the launch event.
The projected benefit of every stage.
The names of the client's staff.
A list of other campaigns.
questions.explanation: 男性2は、各段階で見込まれる利益を一行加えてほしいと頼んでいる。

title: Shared printer schedule
script:
Woman: Hi, Ahmed. The new printer on the second floor is booked all week for the training team.
Man: That's a problem. Our contracts have to be printed by Thursday.
Woman 2: I could take the printer in the afternoon, after the training ends at three.
Man: That's too late for us. The courier picks up at four, and the papers need to be sealed first.
Woman: Then maybe you could use the small printer in the copy room instead.
Man: That one doesn't handle the thick paper our contracts use.
Woman 2: If you send me the files now, I can print them before the training starts at nine.
translation:
女性:アハメドさん、2階の新しいプリンターは研修チームが今週ずっと予約しています。
男性:困ったな。契約書を木曜までに印刷しないといけないんだ。
女性2:研修が3時に終わったあとの午後なら、私がプリンターを使えますよ。
男性:それでは遅すぎるよ。宅配便が4時に取りに来て、書類は先に封をしないといけないんだ。
女性:じゃあ、代わりにコピー室の小さいプリンターを使ったら?
男性:あれは契約書で使う厚い紙に対応していないんだ。
女性2:今ファイルを送ってくれれば、研修が9時に始まる前に印刷できますよ。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "That's too late for us"?
choices: The afternoon time would not leave enough time for the courier.
The training will finish after the contracts are due.
The printer will be broken by the afternoon.
The courier has already picked up the papers.
questions.explanation: 男性は、午後では宅配便の集荷に間に合わないという意味で言っている。

questions.question: Why can't the man use the printer in the copy room?
choices: It is reserved for the training team.
It is too far from the courier's office.
It cannot print the thick paper used for contracts.
It has been broken since Monday.
questions.explanation: 男性は、コピー室のプリンターは契約書で使う厚い紙に対応していないと言っている。

questions.question: What does the second woman offer to do?
choices: Move the training to Friday.
Pick up the contracts from the courier.
Buy a new printer for the team.
Print the files before the training begins.
questions.explanation: 女性2は、研修が始まる前にファイルを印刷できると申し出ている。

title: Warehouse expansion timeline
graphic:
Warehouse expansion: milestones
Milestone            Planned date    Status
Land purchase        March 3         Done
Foundation work      April 12        Delayed
Steel frame          May 20          On track
Racking installed    June 30         At risk
script:
Man: The land purchase closed on time, but the foundation crew is behind schedule.
Woman: The rain delayed the concrete pour by almost two weeks, so the steel frame can't start until the foundation is set.
Man 2: That doesn't have to slow everything down. The frame company can assemble the parts in the yard meanwhile.
Man: Maybe, but the racking team needs the building to be closed in before they can start. That's the real bottleneck.
Woman: So if the frame goes up by May 20, the racking can still finish in June, as planned.
Man: Only if the roof is done, and right now nobody has confirmed the roofing crew.
Woman: Then let's call the roofing company today before we commit to the June date.
translation:
男性:土地の購入は予定どおり終わったけど、基礎工事の作業班が遅れている。
女性:雨でコンクリートの打設が2週間近く延びたから、基礎が固まるまで鉄骨は始められないわ。
男性2:それで全体が遅れるわけではないですよ。その間に鉄骨メーカーが庭で部材を組み立てられます。
男性:そうかもしれないけど、棚の設置チームは建物の屋根が閉じられるまで始められない。そこが本当のボトルネックなんだ。
女性:だから、鉄骨が5月20日までに立てば、予定どおり6月中に棚の設置も終わるということね。
男性:屋根の工事が終わればの話だけど、今のところ屋根の業者はまだ確定していないんだ。
女性:じゃあ、6月の日程を確定させる前に、今日屋根の会社に電話しましょう。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which milestone is most likely to be late?
choices: The land purchase, which has already been completed.
The steel frame, which is on track.
The racking installation, because the roof is not confirmed.
The foundation work, which has already been done.
questions.explanation: 表では棚の設置が「要注意」。屋根の業者がまだ決まっていないため、建物が閉じられず遅れるおそれがある。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "That's the real bottleneck"?
choices: The land purchase took too long to finish.
The steel frame has to be assembled by hand.
The racking team has too many members.
The building must be closed in before the racking can start.
questions.explanation: 男性は、棚の設置は建物が閉じられてから始まるので、そこが最大の制約だという意味で言っている。

questions.question: What will the woman do before committing to the June date?
choices: Phone the company responsible for the roof today.
Confirm the steel frame delivery.
Ask the racking team to start earlier.
Move the land purchase to April.
questions.explanation: 女性は、6月の日程を確定させる前に今日屋根の会社に電話すると言っている。

title: Survey results and the client
script:
Woman: Gary, the client wants the survey results before the board meeting on Tuesday.
Man: The response rate is only about thirty percent. I don't think the figures are reliable yet.
Man 2: The sample is large enough for a rough picture, I think. The early trends look consistent.
Woman: The client will ask why we only sent the survey to one region. That will raise questions.
Man: We could explain that we tested the questionnaire in that region first.
Woman: They'll want more than an explanation. Can we send a reminder to the other regions this week?
Man: Yes, but the reminder would only reach people who didn't respond the first time.
translation:
女性:ゲイリー、顧客は火曜の役員会の前にアンケート結果を見たいそうよ。
男性:回答率は3割ほどしかないんだ。まだ数字が信頼できるとは思えない。
男性2:大まかな傾向をつかむには十分な数だと思います。初期の傾向は一貫しているようです。
女性:顧客は、なぜ一つの地域にしかアンケートを送らなかったのかと聞いてくるでしょうね。それが問題になるわ。
男性:あの地域で先に質問票をテストしたと説明できるよ。
女性:説明だけでは足りないでしょうね。今週、ほかの地域にもリマインダーを送れないかしら。
男性:できるけど、リマインダーが届くのは最初に回答しなかった人だけになるよ。

questions.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "They'll want more than an explanation"?
choices: The client has already received the results.
The client prefers a shorter board meeting.
A simple explanation will not satisfy the client.
The client will cancel the survey.
questions.explanation: 女性は、説明だけでは顧客は納得しないだろうと言っている。

questions.question: Why does the man think a reminder may not help much?
choices: The other regions have already closed the survey.
It would only reach people who did not reply the first time.
The client has banned any more survey emails.
The questionnaire is too long to resend.
questions.explanation: 男性は、リマインダーは最初に回答しなかった人にしか届かないので、効果が限られると言っている。

questions.question: What is the main concern of the second man?
choices: The sample is large enough to see the trends.
The board meeting is on the wrong day.
The response rate is higher than expected.
The client has asked for a new survey.
questions.explanation: 男性2は、回答数は大まかな傾向をつかむのに十分だと言っている。

title: Retracted vendor proposal
script:
Man: Diane, the vendor's latest proposal came in. They're offering the software at forty percent less.
Woman: That sounds great, but I got a call this morning saying that price only applies to a three-year contract.
Man 2: Then it isn't a discount for us. We'd be locked in for longer than we planned.
Man: Wait, I read the email again. It says the discount is for annual payment, not the contract length.
Woman: Then the earlier message I got was wrong. Their finance team sent a correction an hour ago.
Man 2: So the correct figure is the annual one, which is still lower than our current cost.
Man: Right. I'll withdraw the three-year option from the comparison and use the annual price.
Woman: Good. Let's go with the annual plan and recheck the numbers before we sign.
translation:
男性:ダイアン、業者の最新の提案が届いたよ。ソフトウェアを4割引にするそうだ。
女性:いいわね。でも今朝の電話では、その価格は3年契約の場合だけだと言われたわ。
男性2:それなら私たちには割引にならないですね。予定より長く縛られてしまいます。
男性:待って、メールをもう一度読んだよ。割引は契約期間ではなく、年払いの場合だと書いてある。
女性:じゃあ、私が受けた前の連絡は間違っていたのね。業者の経理チームが1時間前に訂正を送ってきたわ。
男性2:それなら正しい数字は年払いのほうですね。それでも今の費用より安いです。
男性:そうだね。比較から3年契約の案を外して、年払いの価格を使うよ。
女性:いいわ。年払いにして、契約する前にもう一度数字を確認しましょう。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "I'll withdraw the three-year option"?
choices: He will cancel the software purchase entirely.
He wants to sign a longer contract with the vendor.
He is asking the vendor to lower the annual price.
He is removing the three-year plan from the comparison.
questions.explanation: 男性は、訂正により有効でなくなった3年契約の案を比較から外すと言っている。

questions.question: Which information is now considered correct?
choices: The reduced price is for yearly billing.
The discount applies to a three-year contract.
The vendor will raise the price next month.
The software costs more than the current system.
questions.explanation: メールの再読と業者の訂正により、割引は年払いの場合だと分かった。

questions.question: What will the woman probably do next?
choices: Sign the three-year contract right away.
Choose the annual plan and recheck the numbers before signing.
Call the vendor's finance team again tomorrow.
Ask the second man to cancel the proposal.
questions.explanation: 女性は年払いの契約にし、署名の前に数字を確認しようと言っている。

title: Conflicting venue reports
script:
Woman: Kenji, the venue for the conference was switched to the north hall yesterday, right?
Man: That was the first plan, but the fire inspection failed there last week, so it's off.
Man 2: I heard from the venue manager that the north hall passed after repairs on Monday.
Woman: Then we can go back to the original hall. But the caterer told me the kitchen is smaller there.
Man: We can ask them to bring extra staff. And the first floor is the only one with a wheelchair ramp.
Woman: That's true. Accessibility matters more than the kitchen, so let's stay with the north hall.
Man 2: Please confirm it with the manager in writing before we send out the invitations.
translation:
女性:ケンジ、会議の会場は昨日、北ホールに変更になったのよね?
男性:それは最初の案だよ。でも先週そこで消防検査に落ちたから、取り消しになったんだ。
男性2:会場の責任者から、修理のあと月曜に北ホールが合格したと聞きましたよ。
女性:じゃあ、元のホールに戻せるわね。でも仕出しの業者は、そっちのキッチンは小さいと言っていたわ。
男性:キッチンには追加のスタッフを頼めばいい。それに1階にしかスロープ付きの入り口がないよ。
女性:そうね。キッチンより利用のしやすさのほうが大事だわ。やはり北ホールにしましょう。
男性2:招待状を送る前に、責任者に文書で確認してください。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "it's off"?
choices: The north hall is open only on weekends.
The conference has been moved to another city.
The first plan was approved by the inspectors.
The north hall was cancelled because it failed the inspection.
questions.explanation: 男性は、先週の消防検査に落ちたため北ホールの案は取り消されたと言っている。

questions.question: Why does the woman decide to keep the north hall?
choices: Its kitchen is larger than the original hall's.
It is easier for guests to access it.
The caterer has agreed to a lower price.
Its inspection was done last week.
questions.explanation: 女性は、キッチンよりも利用のしやすさが大事だと判断し、北ホールに決めている。

questions.question: What does the second man ask the team to do?
choices: Send out the invitations immediately.
Hire extra staff for the kitchen.
Move the conference to the first floor.
Get written approval of the location from the person in charge.
questions.explanation: 男性2は、招待状を送る前に責任者に文書で確認するよう求めている。
